general_background.title: Oleylamine can act as both solvent and reductant
general_background.summary: In amine-mediated noble-metal syntheses, oleylamine can help reduce the metal precursor while also binding the particle surface. Reduction and adsorption therefore affect both the formation of nuclei and the persistence of exposed facets.
